description: Implementation of the SpdyFrameBuilder class for constructing SPDY protocol frames, including methods for buffer management, frame initialization, and data writing.

classes.name: SpdyFrameBuilder
classes.description: A class for building SPDY protocol frames with buffer management and frame serialization capabilities.

methods.name: GetWritableBuffer
methods.description: Returns a writable buffer pointer if enough space is available.

methods.name: GetWritableOutput
methods.description: Provides a writable output buffer from the ZeroCopyOutputBuffer.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Advances the write position by a specified length.

methods.name: BeginNewFrame
methods.description: Initializes a new SPDY frame with specified type, flags, and stream ID.

methods.name: BeginNewFrame
methods.description: Overloaded; initializes a new SPDY frame with specified type, flags, stream ID, and length.

methods.name: BeginNewUncheckedFrame
methods.description: Starts a new frame without validation of frame type.

methods.name: BeginNewFrameInternal
methods.description: Internal method to initialize a frame with raw frame type and parameters.

methods.name: WriteStringPiece32
methods.description: Writes a string piece with a 32-bit length prefix.

methods.name: WriteBytes
methods.description: Writes raw bytes to the buffer or output.

methods.name: CanWrite
methods.description: Checks if a specified number of bytes can be written to the buffer/output.
